# Recoleta Tour

> Independent visitor guide to Recoleta Cemetery in Buenos Aires: how to find Eva Perón's tomb, the entry fee and hours (2026), a self-guided route through the maze, the legends and the funerary art, and respectful-visit etiquette — plus a self-guided offline audio tour by TouringBee (22 stops, English and Spanish). Site available in 8 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish and Russian.

This site is a TouringBee project. It is independent and not affiliated with the Cementerio de la Recoleta or the Government of the City of Buenos Aires. Some links are affiliate links (GetYourGuide, Booking.com, TouringBee); they never affect what is recommended.

## Guides

- [Complete guide to Recoleta Cemetery](https://recoletatour.com/): what it is, the history, the legends, tickets, hours, how to plan a visit.
- [Eva Perón's tomb: how to find it](https://recoletatour.com/evita-tomb/): Where the Duarte vault is, what you'll see, and the 24-year journey of her body.
- [Tickets, entry fee & hours](https://recoletatour.com/recoleta-cemetery-tickets/): The fee for foreign visitors, who goes free, how to pay, hours and the free tours.
- [A self-guided route through the maze](https://recoletatour.com/recoleta-cemetery-self-guided-walk/): A 22-stop route from the portico to the far lanes — in the right order.
- [Guided tour vs audio guide vs solo](https://recoletatour.com/recoleta-cemetery-guided-vs-self-guided/): What each format costs, what you get, and which one fits your day.
- [Best time to visit](https://recoletatour.com/best-time-to-visit-recoleta-cemetery/): Why 9:00 matters, when the coaches arrive, and the seasons turned upside down.
- [All guides index](https://recoletatour.com/guides/): full list of guides and articles.

## Audio tour

- [Recoleta Cemetery self-guided audio tour (TouringBee)](https://touringbee.com/product/buenos-aires-recoleta-cemetery-audioguide/?wpam_id=40): offline map, 22 stops written by a professional historian, narrated in English and Spanish; explore the cemetery at your own pace.
